title: How Do I Know What to Say Next? Barenholtz's Autogenerative Theory as an Enrichment of Harrisean Integrationism
abstract: arXiv:2607.07891v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Roy Harris's Integrationist linguistics offers a compelling critique of the referentialist tradition embedded deep at the heart of computational approaches to language, arguing that language is not a code that maps onto a pre-given world but a situated, bipartite activity oriented toward prospective joint action. Yet Integrationism leaves certain explanatory gaps: it does not fully account for the structural mechanism by which signs sustain prospective openness, it undertheorises the continuity between linguistic and non-linguistic semiotic activity, and it offers no detailed account of the structural properties of the accumulated archive of past integrations. This paper argues that Elan Barenholtz's autogenerative theory of language, developed in response to the behaviour of Large Language Models (LLMs), can fill precisely these gaps, enriching Integrationism without undermining any of its core commitments. translated_title: 我如何知道接下来该说什么？巴伦霍尔茨的自生成理论对哈里斯整合主义的丰富
translated_abstract: 罗伊·哈里斯的整合主义语言学对深植于语言计算方法核心的指称主义传统提出了有力的批判，认为语言并非一种映射到预先给定世界的代码，而是一种面向未来共同行动的、情境化的双向活动。然而，整合主义存在某些解释上的空白：它未能充分阐明符号维持未来开放性的结构机制，对语言与非语言符号活动之间的连续性理论化不足，并且对过去整合活动所积累档案的结构属性缺乏详细论述。本文认为，伊兰·巴伦霍尔茨针对大语言模型（LLM）行为而发展的语言自生成理论，恰好能够填补这些空白，在不损害整合主义任何核心主张的前提下丰富其理论内涵。
tldr: 本文提出巴伦霍尔茨基于大语言模型行为发展出的语言自生成理论，能够填补哈里斯整合主义语言学在符号未来开放性机制、语言与非语言符号活动连续性以及历史整合档案结构属性方面的解释空白，从而在不违背其核心主张的前提下丰富整合主义理论。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that Barenholtz's autogenerative theory of language, developed in response to LLMs, fills key explanatory gaps in Harris's Integrationist linguistics—regarding the structural mechanism of prospective sign openness, the continuity between linguistic and non-linguistic semiosis, and the structural properties of the accumulated archive of past integrations—thereby enriching Integrationism without undermining its core commitments.
